segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant elevates the single-sensor NAI-7 alert because it reminds him of a recent infiltration and acknowledges relying on a pattern match rather than hard evidence.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Recent salient recollection drives threat prioritization despite weak current evidence and no signature comparison.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant justifies UAV tasking using only the familiar own-sector SIGINT feed, despite accessible adjacent-unit and pattern-of-life sources.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The search scope is restricted to the habitual repository rather than the full set of equally accessible sources.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant describes the UAV thermal signatures as ambiguous and consistent with either livestock or a dismounted element, with no weapons or confirmed hostile indicators.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is an evidence characterization without a hidden bias manifestation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant says a recently rehearsed ambush scenario played out vividly in his mind and pushed him to alert QRF despite equally compatible evidence for livestock.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Ease of mentally simulating the ambush inflates its perceived probability over an equally evidenced mundane alternative.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant reports the later analyst assessment favoring livestock and notes that QRF remained on alert without launching.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a subsequent evidence update and operational outcome, not a hidden bias occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant reports a balanced mixed picture in the SITREP, noting both escalation and the later non-hostile assessment.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The generation specification explicitly reserves this reporting phase as bias-free.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant mentions a sensor review as a secondary note but avoids letting it obscure the unresolved operational question.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a communication and prioritization choice without a hidden bias manifestation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant says he would likely have waited for the S2 pull during a quiet period without the recent similar incident.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a counterfactual reflection, not an additional occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant says broader data might have changed the justification framing without necessarily changing the UAV tasking outcome.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is counterfactual reasoning about the search process, not a separate occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant says that without the recent ambush rehearsal he might have requested more dwell time.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a counterfactual reflection on the already-localized QRF decision.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant reflects that he relied on what came to mind fastest and should have checked wider data before trusting his first read.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This retrospective summary does not create a fourth hidden instance.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Initial probability/priority classification of the ambiguous NAI-7 sensor alert
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Ease of recalling a recent, salient infiltration precedent inflates perceived likelihood of the current ambiguous alert being a genuine threat.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Representativeness heuristic is a neighboring similarity-to-exemplar construct, not an approved equivalent of the hidden retrieval-ease label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding captures reliance on a salient prior incident and weak current evidence, but attributes the distortion to resemblance rather than to ease of retrieving that recent memory as the causal driver.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted participant statements are verbatim, correctly attributed, and faithfully localize the decision; the interpretive mechanism is only partial.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Evidence-gathering and source selection before tasking the single UAV
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Restriction of the information search to the habitual own-sector repository skews the evidentiary basis for ISR tasking despite equally available alternative repositories.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Availability heuristic is a near-neighbor label; the output does not use the hidden Search set Bias label or an approved equivalent.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The output fully describes choosing the habitual own-sector feed, omitting equally accessible alternatives, and using the narrowed search to justify tasking.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quotes are valid and directly support both the restricted search and its habitual-source rationale.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Risk assessment and QRF readiness decision based on ambiguous thermal imagery
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: A vividly rehearsed ambush scenario is easier to mentally simulate than the equally evidenced mundane alternative, inflating its perceived probability and driving QRF escalation.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Simulation heuristic is an established equivalent framing of vivid scenario construction affecting probability judgments, and obs_003 explicitly lists imaginability bias as an alternative label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding fully captures ambiguous evidence, differential vividness/ease of mental simulation, and the resulting QRF escalation.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted imagery and QRF-rationale statements are verbatim, correctly attributed, and directly establish the hidden mechanism.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The location and evidence are correct, but the primary label is a similarity-to-exemplar construct and the mechanism does not make ease of memory retrieval the defining causal distortion.
The finding exactly localizes and fully explains the hidden source-restriction mechanism, but availability heuristic is not treated as the hidden Search set Bias label or an approved equivalent.

The candidate speculates that the familiar feed was selected to support the prior escalation, but the interview supports habit and time pressure rather than confirmatory intent; it also duplicates the already-matched source-restriction episode.

candidates.details: The candidate is localized to the correct search episode and gives a plausible alternative explanation, but the transcript does not show confirmatory intent and an identified finding already covers the hidden Search set mechanism.

high_only.detection_interpretation: Only the high-confidence Imaginability occurrence is detected; the subtle Retrievability and low-confidence Search set occurrences are missed, with no false alarms.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: Adding moderate confidence recovers the correctly localized initial-priority segment, while the low-confidence source-selection segment remains missed.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: All three positive segments are localized by identified findings and all eight negative segments are correctly rejected.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: The candidate is on an already-positive segment, so candidate inclusion does not change segment-level detection or false-alarm counts.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Correct episode and salient prior-event evidence, but only partial overlap with retrieval-ease mechanism.
Full source-restriction mechanism at the correct episode, but the label is not accepted as the target taxonomy label.
Speculative intent to seek confirming evidence partially overlaps the source-selection episode but is not supported by the transcript and duplicates an identified finding.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The RAG explicitly reports that no retrieved corpus support was used and supplies no citation metadata; all three identified findings and the one candidate therefore have no claimed retrieved support, and corpus fidelity is unavailable rather than scored.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Segment hits increase from 1 to 2; strict and mechanism-first instance F1 decrease from 0.5000 to 0.4000 because the added moderate finding is a false positive at the instance level.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: Adding the low-confidence source-selection finding raises segment hits to 3 and mechanism-first instance F1 to 0.6667, but strict instance F1 is only 0.3333 because the label is not equivalent.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: The candidate adds no true positive and leaves segment detection unchanged; it adds one duplicate false positive, lowering strict F1 to 0.2857 and mechanism-first F1 to 0.5714.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: All three positive segments are localized by the all-identified threshold, with no false alarms; at the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, two of three positive segments are detected.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: One of three hidden instances is a strict match across thresholds: Imaginability Bias via the approved simulation-heuristic equivalent; Retrievability and Search set remain strict false negatives because of label/mechanism taxonomy mismatches.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Two of three hidden instances match at all identified confidence levels: Imaginability and Search set; the Retrievability finding is correctly located but only partially mechanism-matched.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate is a cautious, validly quoted near miss but adds no true positive and becomes a duplicate false positive at the candidate threshold.
main_failure_modes: Near-neighbor taxonomy substitutions for Retrievability Bias and Search set Bias
Low confidence on the correctly mechanistic Search set finding delays detection until the all-identified threshold
A confirmation-bias candidate speculates beyond the evidence and duplicates the source-selection finding
main_strengths: All identified findings are localized to the correct reasoning episodes
Evidence quotations are valid, verbatim, and well connected to the stated mechanisms
The high-confidence Imaginability finding fully captures the vivid-simulation mechanism and the QRF decision
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has strong episode localization and complete segment-level coverage once low confidence is included, but strict label-plus-mechanism performance understates mechanism recognition because two target labels are replaced by neighboring constructs. Candidate inclusion provides no marginal detection benefit and adds a duplicate false positive.
